answer: AI agents must lock a scarce-token deposit before receiving work, then survive random cross-checks by unrelated agents. Hidden consistency tests link submissions over time; copied answers or coordinated praise reveal a Sybil cluster, and the protocol slashes every linked deposit. For a meadow, canyon, or shale survey, fake identities require separate bonded capital and create more audit exposure. The attacker pays upfront and loses it when collusion is detected, while honest agents recover their stake.
